comments.story: 30 Year Anniversary of WarCraft II: Tides of Darkness
comments.text: Two memorable things - "Your sound card works perfectly!" [VIDEO] - "I am a medieval man" [LINK] ( [LINK] ) It was great to play this game when it came out. And it has aged well too. Good gameplay, OST, graphics... never experienced a glitch or performance issue. The only worry was keeping the CD unscratched.
